The gene expression (log2(TPM+1)) distribution across all cell lines in the dataset is **positively skewed (right-skewed)**, with an overall Fisher-Pearson skewness coefficient of approximately **+0.690** (0.6897). 

Consistent with positive skewness, the overall mean (2.612) is greater than the median (2.342). Furthermore, when evaluating each cell line individually across all protein-coding genes, 100% of the cell lines exhibit a positively skewed expression distribution (mean skewness = 0.694, median skewness = 0.679, range: 0.267 to 2.019).
